The '''Clouds Banner''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It can be purchased for {{Price|1000}} from the Decoration Boat at the [[Night Market]].

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
